subject: Integrated lighting and accessory storage
hook: Warm white or neutral white inside the wardrobe? One flatters, one tells the truth.
ig:
Warm white or neutral white inside the wardrobe? One flatters, one tells the truth.

A: Warm white
Soft and cosy, works beautifully with oak-effect interiors and bedside lamps. The catch: dark colours blur together, so navy and black socks get mixed up at 6am.

B: Neutral white
Closer to daylight, so you see colours more accurately when you're matching an outfit. The catch: it can feel a bit stark in a bedroom at night.

If you dress early in the morning or in a room with little daylight, neutral tends to win. If the wardrobe is part of a calm bedroom scheme and you mostly use it in the evening, warm often feels right.

Which do you pick, and when do you usually choose your clothes: morning or night? Comment below.
